name: comp-35
blurb: Text input showing how many characters remain.
description: A text input (maxLength 8) with a helper text below showing 'X characters left'. Uses useCharacterLimit to track remaining space.
use_when: Shorter fields where you want to emphasize space remaining rather than showing the ratio.
avoid_when: You need inline display of the counter (see comp-34 for that).
a11y: Label linked to input. Helper text has aria-live='polite' and role='status'. Input has aria-describedby linking to helper.
